mapper.select:
select m.PORTFOLIO_ID , m.IND_ID , m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL , m.START_DATE , m.END_DATE , n.IND_NAME , n.IND_TYPE , n.EXPR , n.SUP_FREQUENCY , n.WARN_COND , n.APPROVE_COND , n.FOUL_COND , n.TIME_POINT , y.PORTFOLIO_ID as PORTFOLIO_DTL_ID , y.PTL_BAG_ID from ( SELECT A1.PORTFOLIO_ID,A1.IND_ID,A1.START_DATE,A1.END_DATE,A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL FROM RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR A1 left join PTL_PORTFOLIO A2 on A1.PORTFOLIO_ID=A2.PORTFOLIO_ID where (case when A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then A2.VDATE else str_to_date('1900-01-01','%Y-%m-%d') end) <=str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') and (case when A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then A2.MDATE else str_to_date('2099-12-31','%Y-%m-%d') end) >str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') ) m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID and n.IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and n.TIME_POINT like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{timePoint}),'%')
and n.SUP_FREQUENCY LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{supFrequency}, '%'))
left join (select t1.PORTFOLIO_ID,t1.PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL t1 inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO t2 on t1.PORTFOLIO_ID=t2.PORTFOLIO_ID and t2.MDATE>str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') ) y on y.PTL_BAG_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID
(m.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioCode} or m.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL where PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioCode}))
and m.START_DATE <= str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then str_to_date('2999-01-01','%Y-%m-%d') else m.END_DATE end) > str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d')

select t.CDATE , t.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, t.TDY_ASSET_NETVALUE as tdyAssetNetvalue from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION t INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(CDATE) CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION WHERE CDATE <=str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID ) m ON t.PORTFOLIO_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID AND t.CDATE=m.CDATE

select DEL_ID delId, PRT_BAG_ID prtBagId, IND_ID indId, START_DATE startDate, END_DATE endDate, FINPROD_ID finprodId from RSK_INDIVID_ASSET_DEL
START_DATE <= str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') AND END_DATE >= str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d')

select m.PARA_CODE,m.PARA_GRANULARITY,m.PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE,m.CONTENT from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA n on m.PARA_CODE=n.PARA_CODE
union all
select m.PARA_CODE,'FIX' as PARA_GRANULARITY,'FIX' AS PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE,m.CONTENT from RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE m inner join (select MAX(RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE.VALID_DATE) as VALID_DATE,PARA_CODE from RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE where RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE.VALID_DATE<=str_to_date('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') group by PARA_CODE) n on m.PARA_CODE=n.PARA_CODE and m.VALID_DATE=n.VALID_DATE inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA y on m.PARA_CODE=y.PARA_CODE
